newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 5.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 5.

text.p: These were the main headlines reported by Kuku Radio on Thursday in the earlt afternoon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- The employees of insolvent Oru peat plant have received their wages and other claims.
- Estonian schools will start teaching the basics of state defence.
